chunks: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Hasan, from Abu Muhammad al-Wabshi, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)

In the case of a man who appointed a man to divorce his wife and ordered him to divorce her according to the Sunnah, so he divorced her three times in one sitting. He said: It is returned to being one (revocable) divorce. When three months or three menstrual periods have passed, then it is finalized by one.

key_terms.السُّنَّة: The Sunnah (prophetic tradition/method), here referring to the standard, single divorce procedure.
key_terms.تُرَدُّ إِلَى السُّنَّةِ: It is returned to the Sunnah (i.e., treated as a single revocable divorce).

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on triple divorce pronounced in one sitting according to Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-istibsar clarifies the Shia juristic position that a triple divorce pronounced in a single sitting counts as only one revocable divorce (raj'i), contrasting with the Sunni view of it being final. It establishes a waiting period of three months or three menstrual cycles to confirm the finality of the separation, emphasizing the procedural integrity of the Sunnah in divorce proceedings.
